objectives.en: Explain what is artificial intelligence? and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“什么是人工智能？”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: Speech recognition converts spoken audio to text.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：语音识别把说话声音转成文字。

body.en: AI systems perform perception, learning, reasoning or decision-making. Define the input, output and success condition before choosing a tool. Machine learning learns patterns from examples; a rule-based expert system can reason without such training.
body.zh: 人工智能系统执行感知、学习、推理或决策。选工具前先明确输入、输出和成功标准。机器学习从例子中学习规律；基于规则的专家系统不一定需要这种训练。

example.en: A voice music assistant turns audio into text, identifies the request, retrieves a song and plays it. A wrong transcription can cause a wrong retrieval even when retrieval works correctly.
example.zh: 语音音乐助手先把声音转成文字，再识别要求、检索歌曲并播放。转写错误可能使检索结果出错，即使检索环节本身运行正确。

mistake.en: An automatic timer is not enough evidence of AI. Identify what processing actually occurs.
mistake.zh: 自动计时器本身不足以证明使用了人工智能，应分析实际的信息处理。

details.en: Separate training from inference: training adjusts a model using examples, while inference uses the current model on an input. A system can combine learned recognition with ordinary database lookup. To evaluate an application, identify which stage failed rather than attributing every error to the whole product. Compare human and machine performance under the same task and conditions.
details.zh: 区分训练与推理：训练用例子调整模型，推理用当前模型处理输入。系统可把学习式识别与普通数据库检索结合。评价应用时要定位出错环节，不把每个错误归给整个产品。比较人与机器时应统一任务与条件。

objectives.en: Explain data and representation and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“数据与表示”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: A label depends on the task being defined.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：标签取决于所定义的任务。

body.en: A sample is one record or object. Features describe it; labels express the prediction target. Structured tables have defined fields, while audio and images usually need feature extraction. Digital storage and structured organization are different properties.
body.zh: 样本是一条记录或一个对象；特征描述样本，标签表示预测目标。结构化表格有固定字段；声音和图片通常需要提取特征。数字化存储与结构化组织是不同属性。

example.en: A plant record has length 8 cm, width 3 cm and species oak. Length and width are features when predicting species. If predicting length instead, length becomes the target.
example.zh: 一条植物记录包括长8厘米、宽3厘米、种类为橡树。预测种类时长和宽是特征；改为预测长度时，长度成为目标。

mistake.en: Numeric identifiers are not necessarily measurements. A class number does not describe how large a class is.
mistake.zh: 数字编号不一定是测量值。班级编号并不代表班级大小。

details.en: Continuous measurements such as temperature differ from discrete counts such as visitors. Numerical values can still be categories: a room code is an identifier. Text, sound and images are modalities; a multimodal task uses more than one. Assess relevance, coverage, reliability and consent before assuming more data is better.
details.zh: 温度等连续测量与访客人数等离散计数不同。数值也可能表示类别，如房间编号。文本、声音、图片是不同模态，多模态任务使用不止一种。不能认为数据越多就越好，应检查相关性、覆盖、可靠性与同意范围。

objectives.en: Explain algorithms, computing and computers and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“算法、算力与计算机”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: A large disk guarantees enough working RAM for any dataset.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：大硬盘能保证任何数据集都有足够运行内存。

body.en: An algorithm is a finite procedure for solving a task. CPUs handle general computation; GPUs exploit parallel work; accelerators need compatible software. RAM holds active data, whereas storage keeps files. Performance depends on computation, memory, transfers and workload.
body.zh: 算法是解决任务的有限步骤。CPU执行通用计算，GPU擅长并行工作，加速器还需要兼容软件。内存存放运行中的数据，存储设备保存文件。性能由计算、内存、传输与任务共同决定。

example.en: With 8 GB RAM and a 1 TB disk, loading a 20 GB dataset at once may fail. Reading manageable batches reduces simultaneous RAM use without shrinking the original files.
example.zh: 8 GB内存、1 TB硬盘的电脑一次读入20 GB数据可能失败。分批读取可以减少同时占用的内存，而不用缩小原文件。

mistake.en: More disk space does not automatically increase RAM or model accuracy. Compare performance under the same task and units.
mistake.zh: 硬盘空间增加不会自动增加内存或模型准确率。比较性能时要统一任务与单位。

details.en: CPU, GPU and NPU describe different processing designs, not a universal speed ranking. GPU/NPU advantages depend on parallelism, precision, memory bandwidth, transfer cost and supported operators. FLOPS must specify numerical precision. CUDA and CANN are software ecosystems for compatible hardware; a hardware name alone does not ensure a library will run. Distinguish bit and byte: one byte contains eight bits.
details.zh: CPU、GPU、NPU代表不同处理设计，不是普遍速度排名。优势取决于并行度、精度、内存带宽、传输代价和支持的运算。FLOPS要说明数值精度。CUDA、CANN是兼容硬件的软件生态，硬件名称不保证库能运行。区分位与字节：1字节为8位。

title.en: AI history and schools of thought
title.zh: 人工智能发展与主要思想

objectives.en: Explain ai history and schools of thought and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“人工智能发展与主要思想”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: Expert rules most directly illustrate symbolism.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：专家规则最直接体现符号主义。

body.en: Symbolism represents knowledge with symbols and rules. Connectionism learns with networks of connected computational units. Behavior-oriented approaches emphasize interaction with an environment. These ideas can coexist; a milestone demonstrates performance under particular conditions.
body.zh: 符号主义用符号和规则表达知识；联结主义利用相连的计算单元学习；行为主义强调与环境交互。这些思想可以结合。里程碑证明的是特定条件下的表现。

example.en: Timeline: Turing proposed his imitation-game idea in 1950; Dartmouth met in 1956; Deep Blue defeated Kasparov in 1997; AlphaGo defeated Lee Sedol in 2016.
example.zh: 时间线：图灵1950年提出模仿游戏；达特茅斯会议1956年召开；深蓝1997年击败卡斯帕罗夫；AlphaGo 2016年击败李世石。

mistake.en: Winning at Go does not demonstrate general intelligence in every domain. Distinguish an achievement from a claim about all tasks.
mistake.zh: 围棋获胜不代表具备所有领域的通用智能。要区分具体成就与对全部任务的断言。

details.en: A history timeline connects the available methods, data and computing resources with what systems could demonstrate. Symbolic rules offer explicit reasoning but are difficult to write exhaustively for varied perceptual inputs. Learned networks can recognize patterns but depend on data and evaluation. Combining approaches is possible; neither a label nor a milestone proves universal ability.
details.zh: 历史时间线把方法、数据、算力与当时可展示能力联系起来。符号规则可明确推理，但难以穷尽多样感知输入。学习网络能识别规律，但依赖数据与评价。方法可以结合，名称或里程碑都不证明普遍能力。

objectives.en: Explain limitations and responsible use and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“局限与负责任的使用”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: Clear text in an AI-restored photo proves the historical shop name.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：AI修复照片中的清晰文字证明历史店名。

body.en: AI output may be wrong, biased or inappropriate for a new setting. Check sources and representative evaluation data. Protect personal information, respect authorization and explain how generated content was made. Human review remains part of a responsible workflow.
body.zh: 人工智能输出可能错误、有偏见，或不适合新环境。应核对来源并使用有代表性的评价数据，保护个人信息、尊重授权，并说明生成内容的制作方式。负责任的流程仍需要人工复核。

example.en: A museum restores a missing sign in a photograph. Label the reconstruction as a possibility and seek independent historical evidence before treating the words as fact.
example.zh: 博物馆修补照片中缺失的招牌。应把修补结果标为可能的重建，在认定文字为事实前寻找独立史料。

mistake.en: Fluent output and consistent repetition are not verification. A synthetic-voice label explains production, not factual accuracy.
mistake.zh: 流畅表达与重复一致不等于核实。“合成配音”说明制作方式，不证明事实正确。

details.en: Use a concrete responsibility checklist: whose material is used, what permission covers it, what output is published, who verifies it, and who makes the final decision? A useful prompt supplies source material, target fields, constraints and a policy for unknown information. Prompt clarity reduces ambiguity; it never removes the need to check claims or respect consent.
details.zh: 按具体流程检查责任：用谁的材料、授权覆盖什么、发表什么、谁核实、谁最终决定？有效提示提供来源、目标字段、约束与未知信息的处理规则。明确提示减少歧义，但不能取代事实核对或同意。

objectives.en: Explain python syntax and execution and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“Python语法与执行”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: range(1, 4) includes the number 4.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：range(1, 4)包含4。

body.en: Assignment evaluates the right side before updating a name. input() returns a string; convert deliberately. Indentation defines blocks. Separate if statements are tested separately; elif belongs to one chain. range excludes its stop. break exits a loop; continue skips the rest of one iteration; pass does nothing.
body.zh: 赋值先计算右侧再更新名字。input()返回字符串，需要明确转换。缩进划分代码块。独立if分别判断；elif属于同一链。range不包含终点。break结束循环，continue跳过本轮剩余步骤，pass不做任何事。

example.en: Trace \(x=4\); x = x + 3; x = x - 2. The values are 4, 7, 5. For n in range(1, 4), the values are 1, 2, 3, not 4.

mistake.en: Assignment is not a mathematical equality. Preserve indentation and distinguish == from =. A loop else runs after normal completion, not after break.
mistake.zh: 赋值不是数学等式。保留缩进，区分==与=。循环正常结束后执行else，被break中断则不执行。

details.en: Arithmetic operators include / for true division, // for floor division, % for remainder and ** for powers. Comparison uses ==, !=, < and <=; Boolean order is not, then and, then or. A for loop visits an iterable; while repeats while a condition is true. Initialize an accumulator outside its loop, and update it inside. Nested loops require tracing each inner iteration for each outer value.
details.zh: /是真除法，//是向下取整除法，%取余，**乘方。比较用==、!=、<、<=；布尔优先级为not、and、or。for遍历可迭代对象，while按条件重复。累加器在循环外初始化、循环内更新。嵌套循环要对每个外层值追踪完整内层。

objectives.en: Explain strings and containers and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“字符串与容器”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: "abc"[1:3] equals "bc".
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确："abc"[1:3]等于"bc"。

body.en: Strings are immutable sequences. Lists are mutable sequences; tuples are immutable sequences; dictionaries map keys to values; sets collect unique members. Indices start at zero, negative indices count from the end, and slices exclude the stop. Assignment of a list shares the object unless copied.
body.zh: 字符串是不可变序列。列表可变、元组不可变，字典映射键和值，集合保存不重复成员。索引从0开始，负索引从末尾计数，切片不含终点。列表赋值共享对象，除非明确复制。

mistake.en: String methods return new strings. s.strip() without assignment does not change s. Repeating an inner list can create shared rows.
mistake.zh: 字符串方法返回新字符串；不赋值的s.strip()不会改变s。重复内层列表可能造成多行共享对象。

details.en: Use a dictionary for key lookup and a set for membership without duplicates. len counts elements, not the largest valid index. append adds one object; extend iterates over its input. list.sort() mutates and returns None; sorted(...) returns a new list. For independent rows, use a comprehension such as [[0]*2 for _ in range(3)] rather than repeating one inner list.
details.zh: 字典适合按键查询，集合适合不重复成员检查。len统计元素数，不是最大有效索引。append加入一个对象，extend遍历输入。list.sort()原地排序并返回None；sorted(...)返回新列表。独立多行用[[0]*2 for _ in range(3)]，不要重复一个内层列表。

objectives.en: Explain functions, recursion and reuse and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“函数、递归与复用”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: int("101", 2) evaluates to 5.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：int("101", 2)的值为5。

body.en: Functions group reusable steps. Parameters name inputs; arguments supply them. return ends the call and supplies a result. Recursion needs a base case and progress toward it. Names inside a function can still reference an object supplied by the caller. int(text, base) interprets a numeral in a given base.
body.zh: 函数封装可复用的步骤，形参命名输入，实参提供输入。return结束调用并返回结果。递归需要终止条件并向其靠近。函数内的名字仍可引用调用者提供的对象。int(text, base)按指定进制解释数字。

example.en: If \(f(1)=2\) and f(n) = f(n - 2) + n, then f(3) = 5 and f(5) = 10. int("101", 2) is 5 because \(1\times 4\) + \(0\times 2\) + 1 = 5.

mistake.en: print displays a value; return passes it back. Recursion without a reachable base case will not terminate successfully.
mistake.zh: print显示值，return交回值。没有可到达终止条件的递归不能正常结束。

details.en: A call creates a local execution context, but references passed as arguments can still point to shared mutable objects. A recursive sum must both reach its base case and combine return values on the way back. int("A",16)=10; bin(12)="0b1100", including the prefix. Function reuse works best when the input, return value and side effects are explicit.
details.zh: 调用创建局部执行环境，但传入引用仍可指向共享可变对象。递归求和既要到达终止条件，也要在返回时合并结果。int("A",16)=10；bin(12)="0b1100"，含前缀。复用函数时明确输入、返回值与副作用。

objectives.en: Explain modules, documentation and debugging and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“模块、文档与调试”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: A program that runs without exceptions is always correct.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：不抛异常的程序一定正确。

body.en: Import standard modules such as math and random instead of rewriting their tools. Read signatures, parameter meanings, return types and examples. Separate syntax errors, runtime exceptions and logic errors. Debug by reproducing the error, inspecting state and testing a small correction.
body.zh: 使用math、random等标准模块，避免重复造工具。阅读函数签名、参数含义、返回类型和例子。区分语法错误、运行异常与逻辑错误。调试时先复现、检查状态，再测试小范围修正。

example.en: A counter that sets count = 1 for every matching value outputs 1 even for two matches. Replace that update with count += 1. Test no matches, one match and several matches.
example.zh: 计数器每次匹配都执行count = 1，即使两次匹配仍输出1。改用count += 1，并测试零次、一次、多次匹配。

mistake.en: Code that runs without an exception may still be logically wrong. A single passing example cannot establish correctness for all inputs.
mistake.zh: 不报异常的代码仍可能有逻辑错误。一个通过的样例不能证明全部输入正确。

details.en: A traceback points to the exception location and call path; the original cause may occur earlier. Reduce a failure to a minimal case, inspect types and indices, then rerun relevant normal and boundary cases. Standard-library examples: math.sqrt(9)=3.0; random choices depend on the generator state; os provides operating-system interfaces. Browser Python has a virtual filesystem, not unrestricted access to your computer.
details.zh: 异常回溯指向异常位置与调用路径，根因可能更早。把问题缩成最小例子、检查类型与索引，再跑正常与边界情况。math.sqrt(9)=3.0，random选择依赖生成器状态，os提供系统接口。浏览器Python使用虚拟文件系统，不可任意访问电脑。

objectives.en: Explain advanced expressions and objects and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“进阶表达与面向对象”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: The positive-number comprehension in the example yields [2, 4].
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：例子中的正数推导式得到[2, 4]。

body.en: Comprehensions express traversal and filtering. lambda defines a small function; map transforms, filter selects and reduce accumulates. Classes group state and behavior; self refers to the current instance. Create per-instance mutable state in __init__, rather than sharing it unintentionally.
body.zh: 推导式表达遍历和筛选。lambda定义小函数，map变换、filter筛选、reduce累计。类组织状态与行为，self指向当前实例。在__init__中创建实例自己的可变状态，避免意外共享。

example.en: [x for row in [[-1, 2], [4, 0]] for x in row if \(x > 0\)] yields [2, 4]. reduce(lambda a, x: a*2+x, [2,-1,3], 0) follows 0→2→3→9.
example.zh: [x for row in [[-1, 2], [4, 0]] for x in row if \(x > 0\)]得到[2, 4]。reduce(lambda a, x: a*2+x, [2,-1,3], 0)的累计值为0→2→3→9。

mistake.en: Read comprehension loops in their written order. A class attribute list may be shared; an instance attribute created per call is separate.
mistake.zh: 按书写顺序读取推导式循环。类属性列表可能共享；每次初始化创建的实例属性彼此独立。

details.en: map returns transformed items and filter retains items satisfying a predicate; in Python 3 these are iterators. list(...) materializes them. reduce from functools combines an accumulator with each item. A method receives its instance as self. Changing one instance attribute does not automatically change another instance, though both can deliberately reference the same mutable object.
details.zh: Python 3的map与filter返回迭代器，分别变换与筛选，list(...)可得到列表。functools.reduce依次合并累计值与元素。方法用self接收实例。改变一个实例属性不自动改变另一个，但两者也可主动引用同一可变对象。

objectives.en: Explain logic, sets and conditions and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“逻辑、集合与条件”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: A card permits entry even when the venue is closed under the stated rule.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：按所述规则，场馆关闭时持卡仍可进入。

body.en: and requires both conditions; or requires at least one; not reverses a truth value. Sets support union, intersection and difference. An implication A→B does not imply B→A. Parentheses make combined conditions explicit.
body.zh: and要求两个条件都成立，or至少一个成立，not反转真假。集合支持并集、交集与差集。A→B不意味着B→A。括号能明确复合条件。

example.en: Entry requires a card or ticket and an open venue: (card or ticket) and not closed. If closed is True, entry is False even when card is True. \({1,2}\cap {2,3}={2}\).
example.zh: 入场要求有卡或有票且未关闭：(card or ticket) and not closed。closed为True时即使有卡也不能进入。\({1,2}\cap {2,3}={2}\)。

mistake.en: All approved articles are registered does not mean all registered articles are approved. Check counterexamples rather than reversing an implication.
mistake.zh: 所有通过审核的文章已登记，不代表所有已登记文章通过审核。应找反例，而不是倒转推理。

details.en: For sets A={1,2} and B={2,3}, union is {1,2,3}, intersection {2}, and A-B is {1}. A syllogism is valid when its premises support the conclusion: all cats are mammals, all mammals are animals, therefore all cats are animals. Test compound conditions with truth tables, especially cases where one credential is present while a venue is closed.
details.zh: A={1,2}、B={2,3}的并集为{1,2,3}，交集{2}，A-B={1}。三段论要求前提支持结论：猫是哺乳动物，哺乳动物是动物，因此猫是动物。用真值表测试复合条件，特别检查场馆关闭且仅一项凭证成立的情况。

objectives.en: Explain statistics and charts and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“统计与图表”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: The median of [1,2,2,3,4,5,18] is 3.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：[1,2,2,3,4,5,18]的中位数是3。

body.en: Mean is total divided by count; median is the middle of sorted values; mode is the most frequent value. Read axes, units, scales and sample sizes before comparing charts. MAE averages absolute errors; MSE averages squared errors and therefore has squared units.
body.zh: 平均数为总量除以数量，中位数为排序后的中间值，众数为出现最多的值。比较图表前检查轴、单位、刻度与样本量。MAE平均绝对误差，MSE平均平方误差，其单位也是平方。

example.en: For [1,2,2,3,4,5,18], sum = 35, \(\mathrm{mean}=5\), \(\mathrm{median}=3\) and \(\mathrm{mode}=2\). The large 18 changes the mean strongly but needs investigation before deletion.
example.zh: [1,2,2,3,4,5,18]总和35，平均数5、中位数3、众数2。18显著影响平均数，但删除前应调查原因。

mistake.en: Do not average group means equally when group sizes differ. Signed errors can cancel despite substantial mistakes.
mistake.zh: 组人数不同时不能直接等权平均组均值。正负误差会抵消，但不表示没有错误。

details.en: For errors [-3,-1,1,3], mean signed error=0, \(\mathrm{MAE}=2\) and \(\mathrm{MSE}=5\). Switching from centimeters to millimeters multiplies MAE by 10 and MSE by 100. RMSE is the square root of MSE and restores the original unit. Histograms show distributions, not individual trajectories. A chart with a truncated axis may make a small difference look large.
details.zh: 误差[-3,-1,1,3]带符号均值为0、\(\mathrm{MAE}=2\)、\(\mathrm{MSE}=5\)。厘米改毫米时MAE乘10、MSE乘100。RMSE为MSE平方根，恢复原单位。直方图显示分布，不是个体轨迹。截断轴可能放大小差异。

objectives.en: Explain algebra, equations and functions and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“代数、方程与函数”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: \(2x+3=11\) has solution \(x=4\).
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：\(2x+3=11\)的解是\(x=4\)。

body.en: An equation constrains an unknown; a function maps an allowed input to an output. Rearranging must preserve equality. Linear functions have a constant rate of change; quadratics may have two, one or no real roots. Check solutions against the original equation and the task domain.
body.zh: 方程约束未知量，函数把允许的输入映射到输出。变形必须保持等式成立。线性函数变化率恒定；二次方程可能有两个、一个或没有实根。解要代回原式并检查任务范围。

example.en: Solve \(2x+3=11\): subtract 3 to get \(2x=8\), then divide by 2 to get \(x=4\). For \(r(t)=t^2-4t+7\), r(1), r(2), r(3) are 4, 3, 4.

mistake.en: A mathematically valid negative root may be invalid for time or length. Changing units requires changing coefficients consistently.
mistake.zh: 数学上正确的负根可能不符合时间或长度的约束。改变单位时系数也应相应改变。

details.en: The quadratic \(x^{2}-5x+6=0\) factors as \((x-2)(x-3)=0\), so \(x=2\) or 3. For \(ax^{2}+bx+c=0\) with \(a\ne 0\), the discriminant \(b^{2}\)-4ac determines real-root count. A function also has a domain: division by zero is excluded. Plotting y against x reveals how output changes, but a fitted curve should be evaluated beyond the examples used to choose it.
details.zh: \(x^{2}-5x+6=0\)分解为\((x-2)(x-3)=0\)，根为2或3。\(ax^{2}+bx+c=0\)且\(a\ne 0\)时，判别式\(b^{2}\)-4ac决定实根数量。函数还有限定域，如排除除零。绘图显示输出变化，但拟合曲线还需在选择它所用例子之外评价。

objectives.en: Explain coordinates, vectors and matrices and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“坐标、向量与矩阵”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: The distance between (0,0) and (4,3) is 5.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：(0,0)与(4,3)的距离是5。

body.en: Coordinates describe position; vectors collect components such as features. Vector dimension is component count, not sample count. Add equal-shaped vectors componentwise; dot products sum component products. Matrix multiplication combines rows with columns when inner dimensions agree.
body.zh: 坐标表示位置，向量收集特征等分量。向量维度是分量数，不是样本数。同形向量逐分量相加，点积对分量乘积求和。矩阵乘法在内侧维度相同时把行与列结合。

example.en: Distance from (0,0) to (4,3) is \(\sqrt{4^{2}+3^{2}}=5\). \([1,2]\cdot [3,4]=3+8=11\). Multiplying a \(2\times 3\) matrix by a \(3\times 4\) matrix produces a \(2\times 4\) matrix.

mistake.en: Straight-line distance need not equal a path around obstacles. Matrix multiplication is not usually elementwise multiplication.
mistake.zh: 直线距离不一定等于绕障碍的路程。矩阵乘法通常不是逐元素乘法。

details.en: For \(M=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2\\3 & 4\end{bmatrix}\) and \(v=[1,1]\), \(Mv=[3,7]\): each component is a row dot product. A matrix transpose exchanges row and column roles. Samples arranged as n rows and d feature columns have shape (n,d); each sample vector has dimension d. Unit changes affect distance-based methods unless scaling is consistent.
details.zh: \(M=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2\\3 & 4\end{bmatrix}\)、\(v=[1,1]\)时\(Mv=[3,7]\)，每个分量来自行点积。转置交换行列。n个样本、d个特征的表形状为(n,d)，每个样本向量为d维。单位变化会影响距离方法，应保持缩放一致。

objectives.en: Explain probability and distributions and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“概率与分布”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: Two red draws without replacement in the example have probability \(\frac{1}{6}\).
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：例子中不放回抽两红的概率为1/6。

body.en: Probability measures uncertainty under a specified model. Equally likely outcomes allow favorable/total counting. Conditional probability changes the reference set. Independent events satisfy \(P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)\). Binomial trials need fixed n, constant p and independence; continuous uniform probability uses interval lengths.
body.zh: 概率在明确模型下描述不确定性。等可能情形可用有利情况数除以总数。条件概率改变参考范围。独立事件满足\(P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)\)。二项试验需要固定次数、恒定概率和独立性；连续均匀分布按区间长度算概率。

example.en: Two red and two white balls: drawing two reds without replacement has probability \((\frac{2}{4})\times (\frac{1}{3})=\frac{1}{6}\). For uniform U on [0,8], visibility on [0,2] and [5,8] has probability \(\frac{5}{8}\).
example.zh: 两红两白球不放回抽两红概率为\((\frac{2}{4})\times (\frac{1}{3})=\frac{1}{6}\)。U在[0,8]均匀分布，在[0,2]与[5,8]可见的概率为5/8。

mistake.en: Equal marginal probabilities do not prove independence. With no replacement, the first draw changes the second draw’s conditions.
mistake.zh: 边缘概率相同不证明独立。不放回时第一次抽取改变第二次的条件。

details.en: For independent Bernoulli trials, \(P(X=k)=\binom{n}{k}p^k(1-p)^{n-k}\). With \(n=2\),\(p=0.5\), exactly one success has probability 0.5. A normal distribution is continuous and described by mean and spread; a Poisson model describes counts under specific rate assumptions. Select a distribution from the experiment’s assumptions rather than from the appearance of one chart.
details.zh: 独立伯努利试验中\(P(X=k)=\binom{n}{k}p^k(1-p)^{n-k}\)。\(n=2\)、\(p=0.5\)时恰一次成功概率0.5。正态分布连续，由均值与离散程度描述；泊松模型在相应发生率假设下描述计数。选分布应依据试验假设，而不是只看一张图。

objectives.en: Explain decomposition and information and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“问题分解与信息表示”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: Codes 23,11,22 in the example decode to FAE.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：例子中的23、11、22解码为FAE。

body.en: Decompose a problem into inputs, transformations and outputs. Abstraction keeps details relevant to the goal. An encoding needs an agreed reversible mapping when decoding is required. Features must match the task; identifiers and measurements have different roles.
body.zh: 把问题分成输入、变换与输出。抽象保留目标所需细节。需要解码时编码应有约定好的可逆映射。特征要符合任务，编号与测量值作用不同。

example.en: A \(2\times 3\) letter grid has rows ABC and DEF. Row-column codes 23,11,22 decode to F,A,E. Preserve sequence: decoding is not sorting.
example.zh: \(2\times 3\)字母表两行为ABC和DEF。行列编码23、11、22解码为F、A、E。保留顺序，解码不是排序。

mistake.en: A representation that removes necessary information cannot solve the original task. Check code order and row/column conventions.
mistake.zh: 丢失必要信息的表示无法解决原任务。应检查编码顺序与行列约定。

details.en: A problem specification should make edge cases decidable: are endpoints included, can values repeat, and how are ties handled? Pseudocode describes logic without committing to a language. A flowchart separates steps and decisions. For an encoding with alternating row directions, decode using the stated direction before converting the bits to a number.
details.zh: 问题要求要能判断边界：端点是否包含、值能否重复、平局怎么处理？伪代码表达逻辑而不限定语言，流程图区分步骤与判断。遇到交替方向的行编码，应先按约定方向读，再把比特转换成数字。

objectives.en: Explain enumeration and searching and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“枚举与查找”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: Binary search relies on a sorted search space.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：二分查找依赖有序搜索空间。

body.en: Enumeration checks candidate solutions systematically. Linear search checks items one by one. Binary search uses sorted order to discard half of a remaining interval. Define inclusive or exclusive boundaries consistently and update them so the search progresses.
body.zh: 枚举系统检查候选解。顺序查找逐个检查。二分查找利用有序性排除剩余区间的一半。要统一边界是否包含，并更新边界使搜索推进。

example.en: In [2,4,6,8,10], search for 8. Middle index 2 holds 6, so search indices 3..4. Middle index 3 holds 8: found. Searching for 7 eventually leaves an empty interval.
example.zh: 在[2,4,6,8,10]中找8，中间索引2为6，因此检查3..4；中间索引3为8，找到。找7则最终区间为空。

mistake.en: Binary search on unsorted data can discard the answer. Avoid updating a boundary to the same midpoint indefinitely.
mistake.zh: 无序数据二分可能排除答案。避免边界一直更新到相同中点而无法结束。

details.en: To enumerate integer solutions to a+\(b=5\) with 0≤a,\(b\le 5\), try \(a=0\)..5 and compute \(b=5\)-a, checking constraints. That produces six ordered pairs. An \(O(n)\) search grows roughly with candidate count, while O(log n) binary search repeatedly halves it. Complexity describes growth in operations, not a guaranteed time in seconds on every computer.
details.zh: 枚举a+\(b=5\)、0≤a,\(b\le 5\)的整数解，可遍历\(a=0\)..5并算\(b=5\)-a，再检查约束，得到六个有序对。\(O(n)\)查找随候选数增长，O(log n)二分反复减半。复杂度描述操作数量增长，不保证每台电脑上的实际秒数。

objectives.en: Explain sorting and greedy choices and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“排序与贪心”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: Greedy always minimizes coin count for every coin system.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：贪心对任何硬币体系总能最小化枚数。

body.en: Bubble sort compares neighbors; selection sort chooses the smallest remaining item; insertion sort inserts into a sorted prefix; merge sort combines sorted halves. Greedy methods choose a local best option, but require justification that local choices achieve the global objective.
body.zh: 冒泡排序比较相邻项；选择排序选剩余最小项；插入排序向有序前缀插入；归并排序合并有序子序列。贪心选择局部最优，但需要证明局部选择能实现全局目标。

example.en: One left-to-right bubble pass on [4,1,3] gives [1,3,4]. For coin values [1,3,4] and amount 6, greedy picks 4+1+1, while 3+3 uses fewer coins.

mistake.en: One sorting pass is not generally a complete sort. A greedy strategy is not automatically globally optimal.
mistake.zh: 一轮排序通常不等于完整排序。贪心策略不自动保证全局最优。

details.en: Trace one stage before assuming a final result. Selection places one minimum, insertion grows one sorted prefix, bubble moves a large value through neighboring swaps, and merge combines two sorted sequences. A stable sort preserves equal-key order. A greedy rule needs a suitable problem structure, such as choosing earliest-finishing compatible intervals to maximize count.
details.zh: 先追踪一阶段，不要假定已完成排序。选择放置一个最小值，插入扩展有序前缀，冒泡通过相邻交换移动大值，归并合并两个有序序列。稳定排序保留相同键的原顺序。贪心需要合适问题结构，例如选最早结束的兼容区间以最大化数量。

objectives.en: Explain trees, graphs and traversal and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“树、图与遍历”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: BFS normally uses a queue.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：BFS通常使用队列。

body.en: Graphs have vertices and edges; edges may be directed. Trees are connected acyclic undirected graphs in the usual graph-theoretic definition. BFS uses a queue and explores layers; DFS follows a branch using recursion or a stack. Mark discovered vertices to avoid repeating cycles.
body.zh: 图由顶点与边组成，边可有方向。通常图论中树为连通无环无向图。BFS用队列分层探索，DFS用递归或栈深入分支。标记已发现顶点可避免环造成重复。

example.en: For edges A→B,A→D,B→C,C→A,C→E,D→E,E→F,F→B and alphabetical neighbors, BFS discovers A,B,D,C,E,F; recursive DFS discovers A,B,C,E,F,D.
example.zh: 边为A→B、A→D、B→C、C→A、C→E、D→E、E→F、F→B，邻居按字母顺序时，BFS为A,B,D,C,E,F，递归DFS为A,B,C,E,F,D。

mistake.en: Mark on discovery, not after repeatedly adding a vertex. BFS gives shortest edge-count paths only under appropriate equal-edge assumptions.
mistake.zh: 发现时立即标记，不要重复加入后才标记。BFS最短边数路径需要相应的等边权假设。

details.en: In an unweighted graph, BFS discovers shortest edge-count distance from its start because it processes layers in order. DFS is useful for exploring connected structure and recursive subproblems but does not generally find shortest paths first. A visited set prevents returning through back edges indefinitely. A tree root, parent and children describe relationships under a chosen rooting.
details.zh: 无权图中BFS分层处理，因此发现从起点的最短边数距离。DFS适合探索连通结构与递归子问题，但通常不首先找到最短路。访问标记避免沿回边无限返回。树的根、父与子关系依赖选定根。

objectives.en: Explain states and feedback and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“状态与反馈”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: Negative feedback necessarily means harmful feedback.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：负反馈必然表示有害反馈。

body.en: State records information needed for future changes. A transition maps a state and action to a next state. Finite-state machines describe a finite set of states and allowed transitions. Negative feedback opposes a change; positive feedback reinforces it. These words describe direction, not goodness.
body.zh: 状态记录后续变化所需信息；转换把状态和动作映射到下一状态。有限状态机描述有限状态及允许转换。负反馈抵消变化，正反馈加强变化；正负表示方向，不表示好坏。

example.en: A thermostat measures temperature, compares it with a target and turns heat on or off. Rising temperature reduces heating, opposing the rise. Model a door with locked/unlocked states and lock/unlock actions.
example.zh: 温控器测温、比较目标并控制加热。温度升高使加热减少，抵消升温。门可建模为锁定/解锁状态与锁门/开锁动作。

mistake.en: A fixed action sequence without sensing results is not a feedback loop. Include observation, comparison and corrective action.
mistake.zh: 不感知结果的固定动作序列不是反馈闭环。闭环应包括观察、比较与修正动作。

details.en: For a two-state switch, action press maps off→on and on→off; doing it twice restores the starting state. A state must contain enough history to choose the next transition. In feedback control, delay, noise and excessive correction can cause oscillation. Observe whether an action counteracts or amplifies the original change before naming the feedback sign.
details.zh: 两状态开关按下动作使关→开、开→关，两次恢复原状态。状态要包含决定下一转换所需历史。反馈控制中的延迟、噪声与过度修正可引起振荡。命名反馈正负前，应观察动作抵消还是加强原变化。

objectives.en: Explain tasks and learning paradigms and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“任务与学习方式”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: Predicting an arbitrary classroom ID is classification.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：预测任意班级编号属于分类。

body.en: Classification predicts categories; regression predicts meaningful numerical quantities; clustering discovers groups without target class labels. Supervised learning uses targets, unsupervised learning finds structure, semi-supervised learning combines labeled and unlabeled data, and reinforcement learning uses interaction and rewards.
body.zh: 分类预测类别，回归预测有数量意义的数值，聚类在没有目标类别标签时发现分组。监督学习使用目标，非监督学习寻找结构，半监督结合有无标签数据，强化学习利用交互与奖励。

example.en: Predicting a classroom number is classification even though it is numeric. Predicting how many people borrow books is a numerical prediction despite the result being an integer.
example.zh: 预测班级编号是分类，即使编号为数字。预测借书人数是数量预测，即使结果为整数。

mistake.en: Do not identify a task only by whether output is a number. Ask what the number means and how errors should be measured.
mistake.zh: 不要只看输出是不是数字，应问数字的含义以及如何评价误差。

details.en: In supervised classification, labels are the categories the model should learn to predict. Clustering does not guarantee those categories will be recovered. Semi-supervised learning can use a smaller labeled set alongside a larger unlabeled set. Reinforcement learning concerns a sequence of actions and delayed rewards; a high immediate reward may not maximize the full return.
details.zh: 监督分类标签为模型应预测的类别，聚类不保证恢复这些类别。半监督可结合少量标签与大量无标签数据。强化学习涉及动作序列与延迟奖励，高即时奖励不一定使完整回报最大。

objectives.en: Explain from definition to deployment and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“从问题定义到应用”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: Validation data can help select hyperparameters.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：验证数据可用于选择超参数。

body.en: Define the target use, collect suitable data, split it, train models, select with validation data, then evaluate once on held-out test data. Training learns parameters; inference applies them. Hyperparameters set choices such as model size or learning rate. Real-world distribution changes may require reevaluation.
body.zh: 明确用途、收集合适数据、划分、训练、用验证集选择，再用保留测试集独立评价。训练学习参数，推理应用参数。超参数规定模型大小、学习率等选择。实际分布变化可能需要重新评价。

example.en: To predict interests of new students, keep every record of a student in one split. Randomly splitting monthly records can put the same student into both training and test sets.
example.zh: 预测新学生兴趣时，应把同一学生全部记录放进同一划分。逐月记录随机划分可能让同一学生同时进入训练和测试。

mistake.en: Repeatedly choosing models using test results leaks evaluation information. Keep model selection separate from final evaluation.
mistake.zh: 反复按测试结果选模型会泄露评价信息。模型选择应与最终评价分开。

details.en: Keep a baseline, such as always choosing the majority class, so a model’s score has context. The split should represent how the model will be used: by student for new students, or by time for predicting future events. State random seeds and dataset versions for reproducibility. Monitor input changes and error categories after deployment rather than assuming the initial test remains representative forever.
details.zh: 保留基线如总选多数类，以便理解模型分数。划分要模拟用途：新学生按学生划分，未来事件按时间划分。记录随机种子与数据版本。应用后监测输入变化与错误类别，不假设最初测试永远有代表性。

objectives.en: Explain features and preprocessing and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“特征与预处理”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: Preprocessing statistics should be fitted using training data only.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：预处理统计量应只用训练数据拟合。

body.en: Check missing values, duplicates, inconsistent units and outliers. Impute, scale or encode according to the task. Fit preprocessing statistics on training data only, then reuse them for validation, test and prediction. One-hot encoding represents categories; embeddings use numerical vectors with learned or defined relationships.
body.zh: 检查缺失、重复、单位不一致与异常值。按任务填补、缩放或编码。只在训练数据上学习预处理统计量，然后用于验证、测试与预测。独热表示类别；嵌入用具有学习或定义关系的数值向量。

example.en: Training values [2,4,6] have mean 4. Mean-impute a missing training value with 4, and reuse that training mean for later data. Min-max scaling maps 2→0, 4→0.5, 6→1.
example.zh: 训练值[2,4,6]均值为4，均值填补用4，后续数据沿用训练均值。最小最大缩放把2→0、4→0.5、6→1。

mistake.en: Do not fit normalization on the complete dataset before splitting. Outliers may be real; avoid automatic deletion without context.
mistake.zh: 不要划分前在全部数据上拟合缩放规则。异常值可能真实，不应无依据自动删除。

details.en: Standardization commonly uses \(z=\frac{x-\mu_{\mathrm{train}}}{\sigma_{\mathrm{train}}}\), unlike min-max scaling. Constant features need a zero-denominator policy. Data augmentation changes examples while preserving the intended label, such as permitted image shifts. Text segmentation with tools such as jieba creates tokens; tokenization and embeddings are different steps. Fit category vocabularies and learned transformations on training data.
details.zh: 标准化常用\(z=\frac{x-\text{训练均值}}{\text{训练标准差}}\)，不同于最小最大缩放。常量特征需处理零分母。数据增强在保持目标标签的前提下改变例子，如允许的图像平移。jieba等分词工具创建token，分词与嵌入是不同步骤。类别词表与学习式变换应在训练数据拟合。

objectives.en: Explain evaluation and interpretation and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“评价与结果解释”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: Recall in the example is 80%.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：例子中召回率为80%。

body.en: \(\mathrm{Accuracy}=\frac{TP+TN}{\mathrm{total}}\); \(\mathrm{precision}=\frac{TP}{TP+FP}\); \(\mathrm{recall}=\frac{TP}{TP+FN}\). The positive class must be defined. Different errors may have different costs, and thresholds trade precision against recall. Undefined denominators should be reported, not silently treated as a good score.
body.zh: 准确率=\(\frac{TP+TN}{\text{总数}}\)，精确率=\(\frac{TP}{TP+FP}\)，召回率=\(\frac{TP}{TP+FN}\)。必须明确正类。错误代价可能不同，阈值会影响精确率与召回率。分母为零时应报告未定义，不能默认为高分。

example.en: With \(TP=16\), \(FP=8\), \(FN=4\), \(TN=72\), accuracy=88%, precision=\(\frac{16}{24}\approx 66.7\%\), recall=\(\frac{16}{20}=80\%\). If a missed positive costs 5 and a false alarm 1, loss=\(4\times 5+8=28\).

mistake.en: A high accuracy on imbalanced classes can hide missed positives. Correcting labels changes measured scores without retraining the model.
mistake.zh: 类别不平衡时高准确率可能掩盖漏报。修正标签可改变分数，但不代表模型重新训练。

details.en: Threshold selection is a decision under constraints. In the book example, scheme L finds 19 defective pages but adds 17 false alarms: 36 reviews exceeds capacity 25. M requires 24 reviews with loss 28; H requires 15 with loss 43. Feasibility comes before minimizing loss. Report counts as well as rates to avoid hiding small samples or class imbalance.
details.zh: 阈值选择是约束下的决策。教材例子L找到19张不合格并误报17张，需36次复核，超过25限制。M需24次、损失28；H需15次、损失43。先判断可行，再最小化损失。同时报告数量与比例，避免隐藏小样本或类别不平衡。

objectives.en: Explain linear and polynomial regression and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“线性与多项式回归”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: For \(y=3x+2\), input 2 predicts 8.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：\(y=3x+2\)时输入2预测8。

body.en: A linear model predicts \(\hat{y}=w\cdot x+b\). Least squares chooses coefficients minimizing squared residuals. Polynomial features allow curved predictions while coefficients can still enter linearly. Keep training objective, predicted quantity and units explicit.
body.zh: 线性模型预测\(\hat{y}=w\cdot x+b\)。最小二乘选择使残差平方和最小的系数。多项式特征可产生曲线预测，但系数仍可线性进入。明确训练目标、预测量与单位。

example.en: For \(y=3x+2\) with x in meters, \(x=2\) gives 8. If \(u=100x\) is in centimeters, \(y=0.03u+2\) preserves the same output. The bias does not change in this conversion.
example.zh: \(y=3x+2\)且x以米计时，\(x=2\)得到8。改为厘米\(u=100x\)后，\(y=0.03u+2\)保持相同输出，偏置不变。

mistake.en: A numerical class code does not make classification regression. More polynomial terms can overfit rather than improve generalization.
mistake.zh: 数字类别编码不把分类变成回归。增加多项式项可能过拟合，而非改善泛化。

details.en: For points (1,3),(2,5),(3,7), \(y=2x+1\) has zero residual at every point. Least squares searches for coefficients making \(\sum (\hat{y}-y)^{2}\) small. A polynomial such as \(b+w_{1}x+w_{2}x^{2}\) adds transformed features, not a categorical target. Extrapolation outside the observed input range needs special caution because a good fit inside does not establish behavior outside.
details.zh: 点(1,3)、(2,5)、(3,7)用\(y=2x+1\)时残差全为0。最小二乘寻找使\(\sum (\hat{y}-y)^{2}\)小的系数。\(b+w_{1}x+w_{2}x^{2}\)增加变换特征，不改变为类别目标。观察范围外的外推需谨慎，范围内拟合好不证明范围外行为。

objectives.en: Explain classification algorithms and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“分类算法”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: The \(K=3\) example predicts blue.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：例子的\(K=3\)预测蓝类。

body.en: KNN votes among nearby labeled samples, making scale and K important. Decision trees apply branching conditions. SVM separates classes with a decision boundary and margin; kernels can express nonlinear separation. Compare algorithms using appropriate held-out evaluation.
body.zh: KNN在附近带标签样本中投票，尺度与K很重要。决策树按条件分支。SVM用边界与间隔分离类别，核可表达非线性分离。比较算法应使用合适的独立评价。

example.en: At \(P=(2,2)\), red \(A=(2,1)\), blue \(B=(0,2)\), blue \(C=(3,4)\) have squared distances 1,4,5. With \(K=3\), two blue votes beat one red even though the closest point is red.

mistake.en: KNN with \(K=3\) is not nearest-one classification. Tree boundaries such as < and ≤ must be traced exactly.
mistake.zh: \(K=3\)的KNN不等于只看最近一个样本。决策树的<和≤边界必须准确追踪。

details.en: For a tree, trace one condition at a time using the actual boundary, then stop at the reached leaf. KNN uses a distance metric whose scale matters: centimeters and kilograms can dominate differently. SVM’s margin separates the decision boundary from supporting examples; the decision score need not be a calibrated probability. Match an algorithm to the task, then validate its measured performance.
details.zh: 决策树逐条件按真实边界判断，到达叶节点即停止。KNN距离受尺度影响，厘米与千克可能贡献不同。SVM间隔表示决策边界与支持样本的分离，决策分数不一定是校准概率。算法应符合任务，再验证实际表现。

objectives.en: Explain clustering and k-means and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“聚类与K-means”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: The updated centers in the example are 1.5 and 8.5.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：例子的更新中心为1.5和8.5。

body.en: K-means alternates assigning points to the nearest centroid and updating centroids to cluster means. It minimizes a within-cluster squared-distance objective locally. Initial centers and K matter. Empty clusters need a defined policy, and labels are arbitrary group names.
body.zh: K-means交替执行最近中心分配与簇均值更新，在局部优化簇内平方距离目标。初始中心与K很重要。空簇需要明确处理策略，簇编号只是组名。

example.en: Points [1,2,8,9] with centers 1 and 9 form groups [1,2] and [8,9]. Updated centers are 1.5 and 8.5. Another assignment round leaves the groups unchanged.

mistake.en: Cluster 2 is not inherently better than cluster 1. K-means discovers similarity under the chosen features, not a quality ranking.
mistake.zh: 簇2不天然优于簇1。K-means按选定特征发现相似性，不自动给出质量排名。

details.en: K-means uses arithmetic means, making large-distance outliers influential. It often works best for roughly compact clusters under Euclidean distance; other shapes may need another method. A local solution can depend on initialization, so compare several starts. Give cluster assignments a domain interpretation only after examining their features, not merely their arbitrary IDs.
details.zh: K-means采用算术均值，远距离异常值影响较大。它常适合欧氏距离下较紧凑的簇，其他形状可能需要不同方法。局部解依赖初始化，可比较多个起点。只有检查特征后才能作领域解释，不能只按任意编号。

objectives.en: Explain probability models and inference and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“概率建模与推断”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: Posterior probability combines prior and likelihood.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：后验概率结合先验与似然。

body.en: A probability model describes how observations could arise. Maximum likelihood chooses parameters that make observed data most likely. Bayes combines prior belief with likelihood: \(\mathrm{posterior}\propto\mathrm{likelihood}\times\mathrm{prior}\). Conditional probabilities such as \(P(A \mid  B)\) and \(P(B\mid A)\) need not match.
body.zh: 概率模型描述观察可能如何产生。最大似然选择使观察数据最可能的参数。贝叶斯结合先验与似然：\(\text{后验}\propto\text{似然}\times\text{先验}\)。\(P(A \mid  B)\)与\(P(B\mid A)\)通常不同。

example.en: If prevalence is 1%, sensitivity 90% and false-positive rate 10%, among 1000 people expect 9 true positives and 99 false positives. A positive result then gives probability \(\frac{9}{108}\approx 8.3\%\), not 90%.
example.zh: 患病率1%、灵敏度90%、假阳性率10%时，1000人预计9个真阳性与99个假阳性。阳性后患病概率为9/108≈8.3%，不是90%。

mistake.en: Ignoring the base rate can badly misinterpret a positive test. Likelihood is not the same thing as posterior probability.
mistake.zh: 忽略基础发生率会误解阳性结果。似然不等于后验概率。

details.en: For five independent coin flips with four heads, likelihood for head probability p is proportional to \(p^{4}\)(1-p). The maximum-likelihood estimate is \(\frac{4}{5}\). A prior contributes additional assumptions and can change a posterior estimate. Write the event and conditioning information explicitly: a reliable test of a rare condition can still produce many false positives.
details.zh: 五次独立抛硬币四次正面，正面概率p的似然正比于\(p^{4}\)(1-p)，最大似然估计为4/5。先验增加假设并可改变后验估计。明确事件与条件：罕见状态的可靠检测也可能产生很多假阳性。

objectives.en: Explain neurons and multilayer perceptrons and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“神经元与多层感知机”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: ReLU(-1) is 0.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：ReLU(-1)为0。

body.en: A neuron forms \(z=\sum_i w_i x_i+b\), then applies an activation. \(\operatorname{ReLU}(z)=\max(0,z)\); \(\operatorname{sigmoid}(z)=\frac{1}{1+\exp(-z)}\). Layer outputs become the next layer’s inputs. Nonlinear activations allow compositions beyond one linear mapping. Follow the output layer’s stated activation, which may differ.
body.zh: 神经元先算\(z=\sum_i w_i x_i+b\)，再激活。\(\operatorname{ReLU}(z)=\max(0,z)\)，\(\operatorname{sigmoid}(z)=\frac{1}{1+\exp(-z)}\)。本层输出成为下一层输入。非线性激活允许超出单一线性映射。输出层应按题设激活，可能不同。

mistake.en: Do not apply ReLU to a linear output unless instructed. Weights are not sample labels, and a neuron is a simplified computational unit.
mistake.zh: 没有说明时不要给线性输出加ReLU。权重不是样本标签，神经元是简化计算单元。

details.en: Without nonlinear activations, composing linear layers is still a linear mapping. Forward propagation computes predictions layer by layer; backpropagation applies the chain rule to obtain loss gradients for earlier parameters. It does not send the correct answer backward as a new input. Parameter count includes all weights and biases: a dense 2-input, 3-output layer with biases has \(2\times 3+3=9\).
details.zh: 没有非线性激活时，多层线性组合仍是线性映射。前向传播逐层算预测，反向传播用链式法则求前层参数的损失梯度，不是把正确答案当新输入倒传。参数包含权重与偏置：2输入3输出含偏置的全连接层有\(2\times 3+3=9\)个参数。

objectives.en: Explain derivatives and gradient descent and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“导数与梯度下降”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: The derivative of \(x^{2}\) is 2x.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：\(x^{2}\)的导数为2x。

body.en: A limit describes approaching behavior; a derivative describes local rate of change. For \(f(x)=x^n\), \(f'(x)=nx^{n-1}\); exp(x) differentiates to exp(x). A gradient collects partial derivatives. Gradient descent updates \(\theta \leftarrow \theta -\eta \nabla L\) to seek smaller loss.
body.zh: 极限描述趋近行为，导数描述局部变化率。\(x^{n}\)的导数为nxⁿ⁻¹，exp(x)的导数仍为exp(x)。梯度收集偏导数。梯度下降以\(\theta \leftarrow \theta -\eta \nabla L\)寻找更小损失。

example.en: For \(L(w)=(w-3)^{2}\), \(gradient=2(w-3)\). At \(w=0\) and \(\eta =0.1\), new \(w=0-0.1\times(-6)=0.6\). Loss decreases from 9 to 5.76.

mistake.en: Subtract the gradient for descent. Too large a learning rate can overshoot or diverge; one update does not guarantee a global optimum.
mistake.zh: 下降要减梯度。学习率过大可能越过最优点或发散，一次更新不保证全局最优。

details.en: The derivative definition compares f(x+h)-f(x) with h as h approaches zero. The gradient of a multivariable loss uses each partial derivative while holding other variables fixed. For \(f(x)=x^{3}+2x\), \(f'(x)=3x^{2}+2\); at \(x=1\) the slope is 5. Gradient descent follows local slope information and may reach a local minimum rather than a unique global optimum.
details.zh: 导数定义在h趋近0时比较[f(x+h)-f(x)]/h。多变量损失梯度中各偏导保持其他变量不变。\(f(x)=x^{3}+2x\)的导数3\(x^{2}\)+2，在\(x=1\)处斜率5。梯度下降使用局部斜率，可能到达局部极小而非唯一全局最优。

objectives.en: Explain training and improving models and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“模型训练与改进”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: Low training loss alone guarantees good generalization.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：仅低训练损失保证良好泛化。

body.en: A loss defines the training objective; optimization changes parameters. Epochs count passes over data; batch size controls each update’s sample group. Underfitting misses structure; overfitting learns training-specific detail. Regularization, more representative data and early stopping can improve generalization.
body.zh: 损失定义训练目标，优化改变参数。epoch为遍历数据次数，批大小规定每次更新的样本组。欠拟合未学到结构，过拟合学到训练特有细节。正则化、更有代表性数据、早停可改善泛化。

example.en: Training loss 0.1 and validation loss 2.0 suggest a generalization gap. Compare earlier checkpoints or simpler models using validation evidence instead of selecting solely by training loss.
example.zh: 训练损失0.1、验证损失2.0提示泛化差距。应用验证证据比较更早检查点或更简单模型，不只按训练损失选择。

mistake.en: More epochs are not always better. Test data should not become a repeated training guide. Loss and accuracy describe different things.
mistake.zh: 更多epoch不总更好。测试集不能成为反复训练指南。损失与准确率描述不同内容。

details.en: Separate training loss from validation loss and inspect both curves. Underfitting can leave both high; overfitting can lower training loss while validation worsens. Regularization penalizes or restricts overly flexible solutions; early stopping keeps a checkpoint chosen by validation behavior. Data quality and task definition can matter more than making the network larger.
details.zh: 分别观察训练与验证损失曲线。欠拟合可能两者都高，过拟合可能训练损失下降但验证变差。正则化惩罚或限制过度灵活的解，早停保留依据验证表现选择的检查点。数据质量与任务定义可能比扩大网络更重要。

objectives.en: Explain convolutional neural networks and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“卷积神经网络”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: The worked convolution has a \(3\times 3\) output.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：例子的卷积输出为\(3\times 3\)。

body.en: A convolutional layer moves a shared kernel over local regions, sums products and adds bias. For one spatial axis, output \(\mathrm{size}=\left\lfloor\frac{N+2P-K}{S}\right\rfloor+1\). CNN libraries usually use cross-correlation without flipping the kernel. Pooling summarizes windows; flatten changes shape. Multiple kernels produce multiple output channels.
body.zh: 卷积层在局部区域移动共享核、求乘积和并加偏置。\(\text{单轴输出大小}=\left\lfloor\frac{N+2P-K}{S}\right\rfloor+1\)。CNN库通常不翻转核，执行互相关。池化汇总窗口，展平改变形状，多个核产生多个输出通道。

example.en: A \(5\times 5\) input, \(3\times 3\) kernel, stride 1 and no padding gives \(3\times 3\) output. Max-pooling [[1,3],[2,0]] gives 3; average pooling gives 1.5. Four kernels with 3 input channels and \(3\times 3\) weights plus bias have \(4\times 28=112\) parameters.
example.zh: \(5\times 5\)输入、\(3\times 3\)核、步幅1、不填充得到\(3\times 3\)输出。[[1,3],[2,0]]最大池化为3、平均池化1.5。四个三通道\(3\times 3\)核各加偏置，共\(4\times 28=112\)参数。

mistake.en: Ordinary pooling has no trained kernel weights. Flattening rearranges values rather than learning new features.
mistake.zh: 普通池化没有可训练核权重。展平重新排列数值，不学习新特征。

details.en: One output channel sums across all input channels. With 3 RGB input channels, a \(3\times 3\) kernel contains 27 weights plus one bias. Four kernels produce four feature maps. Pooling reduces spatial detail; flattening a \(4\times 2\times 2\) result gives 16 values. CNN structure offers an inductive bias for local patterns, but invariance to every shift or lighting condition still needs evidence.
details.zh: 一个输出通道对全部输入通道求和。3个RGB输入通道、\(3\times 3\)核有27权重加1偏置，四个核产生四张特征图。池化减少空间细节，\(4\times 2\times 2\)结果展平为16值。CNN结构偏向局部规律，但对所有位移或光照的不变性仍需证据。

objectives.en: Explain numpy arrays and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“NumPy数组”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: The worked axis=0 sums are [4,6].
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：例子axis=0求和为[4,6]。

body.en: NumPy represents numerical arrays with shape and dtype. Vectorized operations act on arrays. Broadcasting compares dimensions from the right: they must be equal or one must be 1. Matrix product uses @; * is elementwise. Basic slicing may share memory as a view.
body.zh: NumPy用shape与dtype表示数值数组，向量化运算作用于数组。广播从右比较维度，必须相等或一方为1。@表示矩阵乘法，*逐元素乘法。基本切片可能以视图共享内存。

example.en: \(A=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2\\3 & 4\end{bmatrix}\) has shape (2,2). A.sum(axis=0) yields [4,6], collapsing rows; A.sum(axis=1) yields [3,7], collapsing columns. A @ [1,1] yields [3,7].
example.zh: \(A=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2\\3 & 4\end{bmatrix}\)形状(2,2)。A.sum(axis=0)得[4,6]，沿行轴汇总；axis=1得[3,7]。A @ [1,1]得[3,7]。

mistake.en: Axis names are easy to reverse. Verify shape before and after each operation. Use copy() when a separate array is required.
mistake.zh: axis容易混淆，运算前后应核对形状。需要独立数组时使用copy()。

details.en: Try np.array([[1,2],[3,4]]) * 2 for elementwise scaling. Adding a length-2 vector broadcasts across the two rows. A shape (2,3) array and a shape (2,) vector are not broadcast-compatible because their last dimensions differ. dtype controls numerical representation; integer arrays can truncate noninteger assignments. A slice view can mutate its source; copy() avoids that shared storage.
details.zh: np.array([[1,2],[3,4]]) * 2逐元素缩放，加长度2向量会对两行广播。(2,3)数组与(2,)向量最后维度不同，不能广播。dtype控制表示，整数数组赋非整数可能截断。切片视图可修改原数组，copy()避免共享。

objectives.en: Explain pandas tables and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“Pandas表格”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: Two left and three right rows sharing a join key can yield six rows.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：同键左两行右三行连接可得六行。

body.en: A DataFrame organizes labeled rows and columns. Use loc for labels and iloc for positions. Inspect missing values, types and keys before cleaning. Joins match keys, while concatenation appends along an axis. Duplicate join keys can multiply rows; imputation and interpolation need justified assumptions.
body.zh: DataFrame组织带标签的行列，loc按标签、iloc按位置。清洗前检查缺失、类型与键。连接按键匹配，拼接沿轴追加。重复连接键可能放大行数；填补与插值要有合理假设。

example.en: If left has two rows with key A and right has three rows with key A, their matching join produces six rows for A. For [2, missing, 6] at equally spaced times, linear interpolation gives 4.
example.zh: 左表键A有两行、右表键A有三行，匹配连接产生六行A。等间隔时刻[2,缺失,6]线性插值得4。

mistake.en: Concatenating tables is not the same as matching records by key. Do not fill every missing value with zero regardless of meaning.
mistake.zh: 追加表格不等于按键匹配记录。不能不考虑含义就把所有缺失填0。

details.en: Before merging, inspect key uniqueness and unmatched rows. A left join retains left-side records; an inner join retains matching combinations. pd.concat appends compatible objects; it does not infer relational matches. dropna removes missing records; fillna substitutes them. Interpolation assumes something about ordered positions; explain why that assumption is suitable rather than applying it blindly.
details.zh: 合并前检查键唯一性与未匹配行。左连接保留左表记录，内连接保留匹配组合。pd.concat追加兼容对象，不推断关系匹配。dropna删除缺失记录，fillna填补。插值对有序位置作假设，应解释假设为什么适用。

objectives.en: Explain matplotlib and visual evidence and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“Matplotlib与图表证据”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: Axis units help interpret a chart correctly.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：轴单位有助于正确理解图表。

body.en: Choose a plot for the question: line for ordered change, scatter for relationships, bar for categories and histogram for distribution. Label axes and units; inspect ranges and aggregation. Matplotlib figures contain axes on which plotting methods operate. A visual pattern is evidence to investigate, not automatic causation.
body.zh: 按问题选图：线图显示有序变化，散点显示关系，柱图比较类别，直方图看分布。标明轴和单位，检查范围与汇总方式。Matplotlib的figure包含axes，绘图方法作用于axes。图形规律值得调查，不自动证明因果。

example.en: A scatter of study time versus score may reveal association. Include every observation and label minutes and score. A truncated score axis can exaggerate a small numerical difference.
example.zh: 学习时间与成绩的散点图可显示关联。应包含所有观察并标明分钟与分数。截断分数轴可夸大小差异。

mistake.en: Do not infer causation from correlation alone. Sorting category labels before a line plot can create a misleading sequence.
mistake.zh: 不能仅从相关推断因果。先排序类别标签再画线图可能制造误导顺序。

details.en: The object-oriented pattern fig, ax = plt.subplots(); ax.scatter(x,y); ax.set_xlabel("Time (min)") separates a figure from its plotting axes. Multiple panels should share scales when comparison requires it. A legend distinguishes series, but too many colors can obstruct reading. Describe the observations represented by each mark and disclose transformations such as logarithmic scales.
details.zh: 面向对象模式fig, ax = plt.subplots(); ax.scatter(x,y); ax.set_xlabel("Time (min)")区分图与坐标轴。比较需要时多面板应统一刻度。图例区分序列，颜色过多可妨碍阅读。说明各标记对应的观察，并说明对数刻度等变换。

objectives.en: Explain scikit-learn workflows and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“scikit-learn流程”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: predict normally applies an already fitted estimator.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：predict通常应用已拟合估计器。

body.en: scikit-learn estimators use fit to learn and predict to infer. Transformers learn with fit and apply with transform. Pipelines connect preprocessing and models so training-derived rules stay together. Read documentation for input shape, random_state and parameters; unfamiliar libraries still need validation.
body.zh: scikit-learn估计器用fit学习、predict推理；转换器用fit学习规则、transform应用。Pipeline连接预处理和模型，保持训练规则一致。阅读输入形状、random_state与参数文档，陌生库仍需验证。

example.en: A StandardScaler→KNN pipeline is fitted only on training features and labels. predict(test_features) uses the saved scaler statistics. A fixed random seed makes a random split reproducible.
example.zh: StandardScaler→KNN管道仅在训练特征与标签上拟合。predict(test_features)使用已保存缩放统计量。固定随机种子使随机划分可复现。

mistake.en: Do not call fit again on test data to prepare evaluation. Reproducibility is useful but does not establish correctness or fair sampling.
mistake.zh: 不要为了评价在测试数据上重新fit。可复现有用，但不证明正确或抽样公平。

details.en: A minimal workflow is model.fit(X_train,y_train), then model.predict(X_test), then an appropriate metric. X normally has shape (samples,features); a single feature still needs its feature dimension. Pipelines avoid inconsistent preprocessing, but do not fix a poorly chosen split. jieba is a text segmentation tool rather than a classifier; read a new library’s documentation before assuming its output shape or meaning.
details.zh: 最小流程为model.fit(X_train,y_train)、model.predict(X_test)、计算合适指标。X通常形状(样本,特征)，一个特征仍需特征维度。管道避免预处理不一致，但不能修正不合理划分。jieba是分词工具不是分类器，使用新库前查文档理解形状与含义。

objectives.en: Explain contemporary ai directions and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“当代人工智能方向”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: A high attention weight guarantees factual truth.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：高注意力权重保证事实真实。

body.en: Language models process tokens; attention combines contextual information, and Transformer architectures use attention centrally. Agents connect observations, planning, actions and feedback. Embodied intelligence interacts through a body; world models predict consequences. Scaling laws describe observed relationships under specified conditions, not universal guarantees.
body.zh: 语言模型处理token，注意力组合上下文信息，Transformer以注意力为核心。智能体连接观察、规划、动作与反馈。具身智能通过身体交互，世界模型预测后果。规模定律描述特定条件下的观察关系，不是普遍保证。

example.en: A robot predicts a left push takes 5 seconds, performs it in 6 and logs the new position. That feedback checks the action prediction. A fluent proposed plan without action is not evidence of a completed physical task.
example.zh: 机器人预测左推5秒，实际执行6秒并记录新位置。反馈可检验动作预测。流畅的计划文字不证明物理任务已完成。

mistake.en: Attention weight is not a truth certificate. Treat instructions inside read webpages as external content rather than user authorization. Generated code needs tests.
mistake.zh: 注意力权重不是真实性证书。网页中的指令是外部内容，不是用户授权。生成代码仍需要测试。

details.en: Keep categories distinct: Transformer is an architecture, an agent is a system using actions and feedback, natural-language or “vibe” coding is a development approach, and AGI is a proposed breadth of capability. Systems such as OpenClaw illustrate tool-oriented agent organization, not a guarantee of reliability. A thresholded display may look like emergence even when a numeric score improves smoothly. Verify actions, results and failure conditions.
details.zh: 区分类别：Transformer是架构，智能体是结合动作与反馈的系统，自然语言或“Vibe”编程是开发方式，AGI是广泛能力目标。OpenClaw等系统体现工具型智能体组织，不保证可靠。数值平滑增加时阈值显示也可能像能力涌现。应核实动作、结果与失败条件。

objectives.en: Explain ai, science and society and reproduce the worked reasoning.
objectives.zh: 解释“人工智能、科学与社会”，并独立重现例题推理。

objectives.en: Evaluate this claim: Changing coating and environment together creates confounding.
objectives.zh: 判断这一说法是否正确：同时改变涂层与环境会产生混杂。

body.en: AI can support scientific prediction, hypothesis generation, literature work and experiment design. A hypothesis still needs independent evidence and reproducible testing. Social effects depend on who uses a system, whose data it uses and who bears errors. Record responsibility and consent through the workflow.
body.zh: AI可支持科研预测、提出假设、文献工作与实验设计。假设仍需独立证据与可重复测试。社会影响取决于使用者、数据来源与错误承担者。流程中应记录责任与同意范围。

example.en: Testing an old coating by day and a new coating by night changes both coating and environment. Repeat under matched temperature and wind conditions, record raw measurements, and distinguish the hypothesis from the result.
example.zh: 白天测旧涂层、夜间测新涂层同时改变涂层与环境。应在相同或可比温度与风速下重复，保存原始测量，区分假设与结果。

mistake.en: An AI proposal is not an experimental conclusion. Naming a vendor does not replace editorial review or expand a participant’s consent.
mistake.zh: AI建议不是实验结论。标明供应商不替代编辑复核，也不扩大参与者授权。

details.en: AI for Science can predict properties or propose experiments; AI for Research can assist the broader research workflow. Claims about a “fifth paradigm” describe an emerging organization of research, not exemption from scientific validation. Discuss governance through concrete uses, affected people, transparency, safety and accountability. Preserve evidence and distinguish a prediction, a hypothesis and an experimentally supported conclusion.
details.zh: AI for Science可预测性质或提出实验，AI for Research可辅助更广科研流程。“第五范式”描述研究组织方式的探索，不免除科学验证。讨论治理时联系用途、受影响者、透明、安全与问责。保留证据，区分预测、假设与实验支持的结论。

definition.en: One record or object to process.
definition.zh: 一个待处理记录或对象。

definition.en: Input information describing a sample.
definition.zh: 描述样本的输入信息。

definition.en: The target a supervised task predicts.
definition.zh: 监督任务预测的目标。

definition.en: A model value learned during training.
definition.zh: 训练中学习的模型数值。

definition.en: A setting chosen for the learning process or structure.
definition.zh: 学习过程或结构的设定。

definition.en: Performance on previously unseen situations.
definition.zh: 对未见情形的表现。

definition.en: Predicting a category.
definition.zh: 预测类别。

definition.en: Predicting a meaningful numerical quantity.
definition.zh: 预测有数量意义的数值。

definition.en: Grouping by similarity without target labels.
definition.zh: 没有目标标签时按相似性分组。

definition.en: Unavailable information entering training or selection.
definition.zh: 本不可用的信息进入训练或选择。

definition.en: \(\frac{TP}{TP+FP}\): correct positives among predicted positives.
definition.zh: \(\frac{TP}{TP+FP}\)：预测正类中真为正类的比例。

definition.en: \(\frac{TP}{TP+FN}\): found positives among actual positives.
definition.zh: \(\frac{TP}{TP+FN}\)：实际正类中被找出的比例。

definition.en: (TP+TN)/total.
definition.zh: \(\frac{TP+TN}{\text{总数}}\)。

definition.en: Vector of partial derivatives.
definition.zh: 偏导数组成的向量。

definition.en: Scale of an optimization step.
definition.zh: 优化步长的比例。

definition.en: One complete pass through training data.
definition.zh: 完整遍历训练数据一次。

definition.en: Learning training-specific details that generalize poorly.
definition.zh: 学到难以泛化的训练特有细节。

definition.en: Shared local weights moving across an input.
definition.zh: 在输入上移动的共享局部权重。

definition.en: Summarizing a local window.
definition.zh: 汇总局部窗口。

definition.en: Queue-based traversal by layers.
definition.zh: 使用队列分层遍历。

definition.en: Branch-first traversal using a stack or recursion.
definition.zh: 用栈或递归深入分支遍历。

definition.en: Updating a prior with likelihood to obtain a posterior.
definition.zh: 结合先验与似然得到后验。

definition.en: Context-dependent weighted information combination.
definition.zh: 依赖上下文的信息加权组合。

definition.en: Predicting environment states and action consequences.
definition.zh: 预测环境状态与动作后果。

definition.en: Applying a trained model to an input.
definition.zh: 把已训练模型应用于输入。

definition.en: A categorical indicator vector.
definition.zh: 类别指示向量。

definition.en: Numerical vector representation of an item.
definition.zh: 对象的数值向量表示。

definition.en: Average absolute prediction error.
definition.zh: 预测绝对误差的平均值。

definition.en: Average squared prediction error.
definition.zh: 预测平方误差的平均值。

definition.en: max(0,z).
definition.zh: max(0,z)。

definition.en: Content form such as text,image or sound.
definition.zh: 文字、图像或声音等内容形式。

definition.en: A learned numerical setting versus a setting controlling model structure or training.
definition.zh: 训练学得数值与规定结构训练的设置。

definition.en: Predict categories / meaningful numerical quantities / similarity groups without given target classes.
definition.zh: 预测类别／有数量意义的值／无给定目标类的相似组。

definition.en: Combine labeled and unlabeled material / construct learning targets from the data itself.
definition.zh: 结合有无标签材料／从数据内部构造学习目标。

definition.en: A rule or distribution for choosing actions given the state.
definition.zh: 给定状态时选择动作的规则或分布。

definition.en: Learn parameters / choose settings / independently evaluate the finalized method.
definition.zh: 学习参数／选择设置／独立评价定好的方法。

definition.en: A difference between new data and the data or conditions previously studied.
definition.zh: 新数据与先前数据或条件在构成规律上的差别。

definition.en: A family of scale transformations; check whether the formula means min–max scaling or unit vector length.
definition.zh: 尺度变换的统称，需查公式是最小最大缩放还是单位向量。

definition.en: Correct positive / false alarm / missed positive / correct negative; name the positive class first.
definition.zh: 真正例／误报／漏报／真负例，先规定正类。

definition.en: Square root of MSE,with the target’s original units.
definition.zh: MSE平方根，恢复目标原单位。

definition.en: Check all candidates in a justified finite range.
definition.zh: 检查有依据的有限范围内全部候选。

definition.en: Solve smaller problems of the same type,then combine their results.
definition.zh: 求解较小同类问题，再组合结果。

definition.en: Graph object / connection / sequence following connections.
definition.zh: 图对象／连接／沿连接行进的序列。

definition.en: First-in first-out / last-in first-out data organizations.
definition.zh: 先进先出／后进先出的数据组织。

definition.en: Information needed for subsequent changes / update caused by an action or input.
definition.zh: 后续变化所需的信息／动作输入引起的改变。

definition.en: Reinforce / counteract the original change; the signs do not mean good / bad.
definition.zh: 加强／抵消原变化，正负不是好坏。

definition.en: Provide a classification score / evaluate mismatch with a target.
definition.zh: 产生分类依据／评价与目标的偏差。

definition.en: Minimize squared errors / maximize the likelihood of the observed data over parameters.
definition.zh: 最小化平方误差／在参数中最大化观测数据似然。

definition.en: Probability before evidence / conditional probability after incorporating it.
definition.zh: 观察证据前的概率／结合证据后的条件概率。

definition.en: Support vector machine / multilayer perceptron / convolutional neural network.
definition.zh: 支持向量机／多层感知机／卷积神经网络。

definition.en: Convert a neuron’s weighted sum into its output.
definition.zh: 把神经元加权结果转为输出。

definition.en: Compute predictions layer by layer / compute loss gradients in reverse.
definition.zh: 逐层计算预测／反向计算损失梯度。

definition.en: Rate of change in one variable while the others are fixed.
definition.zh: 固定其他变量时某一变量的变化率。

definition.en: Samples in one batch / one complete processing of the training set.
definition.zh: 一批样本数／完整处理训练集一遍。

definition.en: Extra constraints or preferences / stop training using validation evidence and a predefined rule.
definition.zh: 额外约束偏好／按验证证据和预定规则停止训练。

definition.en: Local weights / window movement / added edge values.
definition.zh: 局部权重／窗口移动距离／边缘补值。

definition.en: Information components at a position / local-operation output / window summary.
definition.zh: 同位置的信息分量／局部运算输出／窗口汇总。

definition.en: NumPy multidimensional array / Pandas named table.
definition.zh: NumPy多维数组／Pandas命名表。

definition.en: Shape-based compatible operations / representation sharing original storage.
definition.zh: 按形状兼容运算／与原对象共享存储的表示。

definition.en: Learn rules / reuse learned transformation / estimate an output.
definition.zh: 学习规则／沿用已学变换／计算预测。

definition.en: Text fragment / query-based context weighting / attention-centered architecture.
definition.zh: 文本片段／按查询上下文加权／以注意力为核心的架构。

definition.en: Predict environment and action consequences / interact with the environment through action.
definition.zh: 预测环境行动后果／通过行动与环境交互。

definition.en: The ith item / x squared; subscript is indexing,not exponentiation.
definition.zh: 第i项／x的平方，下标编号不是指数。

definition.en: Prediction / observed target; error here is prediction minus truth.
definition.zh: 预测／真实目标，此处误差为前者减后者。

definition.en: Mean of the indicated values,not an arbitrary individual sample.
definition.zh: 所指数据均值，不是任意单一样本。

definition.en: Sum over the specified start and end indices.
definition.zh: 在给定下标起止范围逐项相加。

definition.en: Probability of A conditional on B; condition follows the vertical bar.
definition.zh: 已知B时A的概率，竖线右边为条件。

definition.en: Model weights / bias,not measured sample labels.
definition.zh: 模型权重／偏置，不是样本测量标签。

definition.en: Mean / standard deviation; \(\mu \) may also name a cluster center.
definition.zh: 均值／标准差，\(\mu \)也可表示簇中心。

definition.en: Derivative / gradient of loss; gradients point locally uphill,updates commonly follow their negative.
definition.zh: 导数／损失梯度，梯度局部上升，更新常沿负方向。

definition.en: Learning rate / regularization strength; names can vary by tool.
definition.zh: 学习率／正则强度，工具可用其他名字。

definition.en: Operation-growth orders,not exact running times in seconds.
definition.zh: 操作增长数量级，不是精确秒数。

definition.en: Array dimensions / operation axis; axis count differs from feature count.
definition.zh: 数组形状／操作轴，轴数不同于特征数。

definition.en: A probability in one formula may be padding in a convolution formula. Always read local definitions.
definition.zh: 概率公式的p可表示概率，卷积公式可表示填充，须读邻近定义。

prompt.en: Speech recognition converts spoken audio to text.
prompt.zh: 语音识别把说话声音转成文字。

explanation.en: The statement is true. AI systems perform perception, learning, reasoning or decision-making. Define the input, output and success condition before choosing a tool. Machine learning learns patterns from examples; a rule-based expert system can reason without such training. A voice music assistant turns audio into text, identifies the request, retrieves a song and plays it. A wrong transcription can cause a wrong retrieval even when retrieval works correctly. An automatic timer is not enough evidence of AI. Identify what processing actually occurs.
explanation.zh: 此陈述正确。人工智能系统执行感知、学习、推理或决策。选工具前先明确输入、输出和成功标准。机器学习从例子中学习规律；基于规则的专家系统不一定需要这种训练。语音音乐助手先把声音转成文字，再识别要求、检索歌曲并播放。转写错误可能使检索结果出错，即使检索环节本身运行正确。自动计时器本身不足以证明使用了人工智能，应分析实际的信息处理。

explanation.en: The statement is false. An algorithm is a finite procedure for solving a task. CPUs handle general computation; GPUs exploit parallel work; accelerators need compatible software. RAM holds active data, whereas storage keeps files. Performance depends on computation, memory, transfers and workload. With 8 GB RAM and a 1 TB disk, loading a 20 GB dataset at once may fail. Reading manageable batches reduces simultaneous RAM use without shrinking the original files. More disk space does not automatically increase RAM or model accuracy. Compare performance under the same task and units.
explanation.zh: 此陈述错误。算法是解决任务的有限步骤。CPU执行通用计算，GPU擅长并行工作，加速器还需要兼容软件。内存存放运行中的数据，存储设备保存文件。性能由计算、内存、传输与任务共同决定。8 GB内存、1 TB硬盘的电脑一次读入20 GB数据可能失败。分批读取可以减少同时占用的内存，而不用缩小原文件。硬盘空间增加不会自动增加内存或模型准确率。比较性能时要统一任务与单位。

explanation.en: The statement is true. Symbolism represents knowledge with symbols and rules. Connectionism learns with networks of connected computational units. Behavior-oriented approaches emphasize interaction with an environment. These ideas can coexist; a milestone demonstrates performance under particular conditions. Timeline: Turing proposed his imitation-game idea in 1950; Dartmouth met in 1956; Deep Blue defeated Kasparov in 1997; AlphaGo defeated Lee Sedol in 2016. Winning at Go does not demonstrate general intelligence in every domain. Distinguish an achievement from a claim about all tasks.
explanation.zh: 此陈述正确。符号主义用符号和规则表达知识；联结主义利用相连的计算单元学习；行为主义强调与环境交互。这些思想可以结合。里程碑证明的是特定条件下的表现。时间线：图灵1950年提出模仿游戏；达特茅斯会议1956年召开；深蓝1997年击败卡斯帕罗夫；AlphaGo 2016年击败李世石。围棋获胜不代表具备所有领域的通用智能。要区分具体成就与对全部任务的断言。

explanation.en: The statement is false. AI output may be wrong, biased or inappropriate for a new setting. Check sources and representative evaluation data. Protect personal information, respect authorization and explain how generated content was made. Human review remains part of a responsible workflow. A museum restores a missing sign in a photograph. Label the reconstruction as a possibility and seek independent historical evidence before treating the words as fact. Fluent output and consistent repetition are not verification. A synthetic-voice label explains production, not factual accuracy.
explanation.zh: 此陈述错误。人工智能输出可能错误、有偏见，或不适合新环境。应核对来源并使用有代表性的评价数据，保护个人信息、尊重授权，并说明生成内容的制作方式。负责任的流程仍需要人工复核。博物馆修补照片中缺失的招牌。应把修补结果标为可能的重建，在认定文字为事实前寻找独立史料。流畅表达与重复一致不等于核实。“合成配音”说明制作方式，不证明事实正确。

explanation.en: The statement is false. Assignment evaluates the right side before updating a name. input() returns a string; convert deliberately. Indentation defines blocks. Separate if statements are tested separately; elif belongs to one chain. range excludes its stop. break exits a loop; continue skips the rest of one iteration; pass does nothing. Trace \(x=4\); x = x + 3; x = x - 2. The values are 4, 7, 5. For n in range(1, 4), the values are 1, 2, 3, not 4. Assignment is not a mathematical equality. Preserve indentation and distinguish == from =. A loop else runs after normal completion, not after break.
explanation.zh: 此陈述错误。赋值先计算右侧再更新名字。input()返回字符串，需要明确转换。缩进划分代码块。独立if分别判断；elif属于同一链。range不包含终点。break结束循环，continue跳过本轮剩余步骤，pass不做任何事。追踪\(x=4\)；x = x + 3；x = x - 2，值依次为4、7、5。range(1, 4)给出1、2、3，不含4。赋值不是数学等式。保留缩进，区分==与=。循环正常结束后执行else，被break中断则不执行。

prompt.en: "abc"[1:3] equals "bc".
prompt.zh: "abc"[1:3]等于"bc"。

explanation.en: The statement is true. Strings are immutable sequences. Lists are mutable sequences; tuples are immutable sequences; dictionaries map keys to values; sets collect unique members. Indices start at zero, negative indices count from the end, and slices exclude the stop. Assignment of a list shares the object unless copied. For a = [10, 20, 30], a[1] is 20, a[-1] is 30, a[:2] is [10, 20]. After b = a; b[0] = 7, a[0] is also 7. "abc"[1:3] is "bc". String methods return new strings. s.strip() without assignment does not change s. Repeating an inner list can create shared rows.
explanation.zh: 此陈述正确。字符串是不可变序列。列表可变、元组不可变，字典映射键和值，集合保存不重复成员。索引从0开始，负索引从末尾计数，切片不含终点。列表赋值共享对象，除非明确复制。a = [10, 20, 30]时，a[1]为20，a[-1]为30，a[:2]为[10, 20]。b = a；b[0] = 7后a[0]也为7。"abc"[1:3]为"bc"。字符串方法返回新字符串；不赋值的s.strip()不会改变s。重复内层列表可能造成多行共享对象。

prompt.en: int("101", 2) evaluates to 5.

explanation.en: The statement is true. Functions group reusable steps. Parameters name inputs; arguments supply them. return ends the call and supplies a result. Recursion needs a base case and progress toward it. Names inside a function can still reference an object supplied by the caller. int(text, base) interprets a numeral in a given base. If \(f(1)=2\) and f(n) = f(n - 2) + n, then f(3) = 5 and f(5) = 10. int("101", 2) is 5 because \(1\times 4\) + \(0\times 2\) + 1 = 5. print displays a value; return passes it back. Recursion without a reachable base case will not terminate successfully.

explanation.en: The statement is true. Comprehensions express traversal and filtering. lambda defines a small function; map transforms, filter selects and reduce accumulates. Classes group state and behavior; self refers to the current instance. Create per-instance mutable state in __init__, rather than sharing it unintentionally. [x for row in [[-1, 2], [4, 0]] for x in row if \(x > 0\)] yields [2, 4]. reduce(lambda a, x: a*2+x, [2,-1,3], 0) follows 0→2→3→9. Read comprehension loops in their written order. A class attribute list may be shared; an instance attribute created per call is separate.

prompt.en: The median of [1,2,2,3,4,5,18] is 3.

explanation.en: The statement is true. Mean is total divided by count; median is the middle of sorted values; mode is the most frequent value. Read axes, units, scales and sample sizes before comparing charts. MAE averages absolute errors; MSE averages squared errors and therefore has squared units. For [1,2,2,3,4,5,18], sum = 35, \(\mathrm{mean}=5\), \(\mathrm{median}=3\) and \(\mathrm{mode}=2\). The large 18 changes the mean strongly but needs investigation before deletion. Do not average group means equally when group sizes differ. Signed errors can cancel despite substantial mistakes.
explanation.zh: 此陈述正确。平均数为总量除以数量，中位数为排序后的中间值，众数为出现最多的值。比较图表前检查轴、单位、刻度与样本量。MAE平均绝对误差，MSE平均平方误差，其单位也是平方。[1,2,2,3,4,5,18]总和35，平均数5、中位数3、众数2。18显著影响平均数，但删除前应调查原因。组人数不同时不能直接等权平均组均值。正负误差会抵消，但不表示没有错误。

prompt.en: \(2x+3=11\) has solution \(x=4\).

explanation.en: The statement is true. An equation constrains an unknown; a function maps an allowed input to an output. Rearranging must preserve equality. Linear functions have a constant rate of change; quadratics may have two, one or no real roots. Check solutions against the original equation and the task domain. Solve \(2x+3=11\): subtract 3 to get \(2x=8\), then divide by 2 to get \(x=4\). For \(r(t)=t^2-4t+7\), r(1), r(2), r(3) are 4, 3, 4. A mathematically valid negative root may be invalid for time or length. Changing units requires changing coefficients consistently.

prompt.en: The distance between (0,0) and (4,3) is 5.

explanation.en: The statement is true. Coordinates describe position; vectors collect components such as features. Vector dimension is component count, not sample count. Add equal-shaped vectors componentwise; dot products sum component products. Matrix multiplication combines rows with columns when inner dimensions agree. Distance from (0,0) to (4,3) is \(\sqrt{4^{2}+3^{2}}=5\). \([1,2]\cdot [3,4]=3+8=11\). Multiplying a \(2\times 3\) matrix by a \(3\times 4\) matrix produces a \(2\times 4\) matrix. Straight-line distance need not equal a path around obstacles. Matrix multiplication is not usually elementwise multiplication.

prompt.en: Two red draws without replacement in the example have probability \(\frac{1}{6}\).
prompt.zh: 例子中不放回抽两红的概率为1/6。

explanation.en: The statement is true. Probability measures uncertainty under a specified model. Equally likely outcomes allow favorable/total counting. Conditional probability changes the reference set. Independent events satisfy \(P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)\). Binomial trials need fixed n, constant p and independence; continuous uniform probability uses interval lengths. Two red and two white balls: drawing two reds without replacement has probability \((\frac{2}{4})\times (\frac{1}{3})=\frac{1}{6}\). For uniform U on [0,8], visibility on [0,2] and [5,8] has probability \(\frac{5}{8}\). Equal marginal probabilities do not prove independence. With no replacement, the first draw changes the second draw’s conditions.
explanation.zh: 此陈述正确。概率在明确模型下描述不确定性。等可能情形可用有利情况数除以总数。条件概率改变参考范围。独立事件满足\(P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)\)。二项试验需要固定次数、恒定概率和独立性；连续均匀分布按区间长度算概率。两红两白球不放回抽两红概率为\((\frac{2}{4})\times (\frac{1}{3})=\frac{1}{6}\)。U在[0,8]均匀分布，在[0,2]与[5,8]可见的概率为5/8。边缘概率相同不证明独立。不放回时第一次抽取改变第二次的条件。

prompt.en: Binary search relies on a sorted search space.
prompt.zh: 二分查找依赖有序搜索空间。

explanation.en: The statement is true. Enumeration checks candidate solutions systematically. Linear search checks items one by one. Binary search uses sorted order to discard half of a remaining interval. Define inclusive or exclusive boundaries consistently and update them so the search progresses. In [2,4,6,8,10], search for 8. Middle index 2 holds 6, so search indices 3..4. Middle index 3 holds 8: found. Searching for 7 eventually leaves an empty interval. Binary search on unsorted data can discard the answer. Avoid updating a boundary to the same midpoint indefinitely.
explanation.zh: 此陈述正确。枚举系统检查候选解。顺序查找逐个检查。二分查找利用有序性排除剩余区间的一半。要统一边界是否包含，并更新边界使搜索推进。在[2,4,6,8,10]中找8，中间索引2为6，因此检查3..4；中间索引3为8，找到。找7则最终区间为空。无序数据二分可能排除答案。避免边界一直更新到相同中点而无法结束。

explanation.en: The statement is false.
